weeks.title: Fundamentals & Assessment
weeks.focus: Establish a baseline of your play and master the fundamentals of positioning and game sense.

tasks.text: Warm-up: role-specific mechanics (aim, movement) — 10 min
Warm-up: hero-specific combos on Practice Range — 5 min
Live warm-up: Deathmatch or Aim Duel — 10 min
Play 3–4 Competitive matches as a baseline benchmark
tasks.note: Track deaths, objective time and key stats.

tasks.text: Watch one full replay of your worst death today — 10 min
Standard warm-up routine — 15 min
Play 2–3 Competitive matches prioritizing survival over kills
tasks.note: Ask: was I alive when fights mattered?

tasks.text: Study one educational video on fundamentals; write down 3 actionable tips
Warm-up routine — 15 min
In Custom Game, walk every map's high-ground and health-pickup routes — 15 min
Play 2–3 matches with one positioning goal per life
tasks.note: Example: never peek without an escape route.

tasks.text: Replay review: mark every positional mistake — 10 min
Warm-up routine — 15 min
Write down the cooldown and best use-case of each ability on your main
Play 2–3 matches saving defensive cooldowns for real threats only
Daily note: which ability did I waste today, and why?
Warm-up routine — 15 min
Play 2–3 matches focusing on even trades before pushing advantage
Review one pro VOD of your role; pause and predict each rotation — 20 min
Warm-up routine — 15 min
Free play: apply whatever felt weakest this week
Weekly review: rank trend, biggest lesson, one goal for next week
tasks.note: Log your rank in Rank History if it changed.

weeks.title: Game Sense & Decision-Making
weeks.focus: Improve understanding of game flow, decision-making, and when to commit or reset.

tasks.text: Warm-up routine — 15 min
Study counters: list the worst hero matchup for each of your mains
Play 2–3 matches; after each comp screen, note one win-condition
Warm-up routine — 15 min
Track enemy ultimates mentally all match; call them out or note them
Play 2 matches committing only when you have ult advantage
Replay review: find one fight lost to bad ult trading
Warm-up routine — 15 min
Play 2–3 matches making every decision around the payload/point timer
tasks.note: Ask: does this kill actually advance the objective?

tasks.text: Daily note: one moment where I overchased instead of playing the objective
Warm-up routine — 15 min
Practice calling resets when behind on numbers or resources
Play 2–3 matches; focus on not dying alone before commits
Warm-up routine — 15 min
Flank/watch-dog awareness drill: check minimap every 10 seconds in 2 matches
Watch a casted pro match; narrate why each team fights or backs off — 25 min
Warm-up routine — 15 min
Free play applying one decision-making goal
Weekly review: decisions improved, decisions still costly

weeks.title: Communication & Team Coordination
weeks.focus: Develop clear, concise communication and coordinate team plays.

tasks.text: Warm-up routine — 15 min
Learn standard callouts for your 2 most-played maps
Play 2–3 matches giving at least one useful callout per fight
Warm-up routine — 15 min
Take initiative: suggest target priority or commit/reset in every match today
tasks.note: Even in Quick Play — low stakes practice.

tasks.text: Daily note: how did the team respond? What phrasing worked?
Warm-up routine — 15 min
Set up one coordinated combo per match (e.g., ult chain, focus target)
Review replays: did my calls match what actually happened? — 15 min
Warm-up routine — 15 min
Play a full session with zero negative comms; redirect blame into solutions
Reflect: how did morale affect our fight outcomes?
Warm-up routine — 15 min
Play 2 matches focused on supporting your tank / protecting your backline (per role)
Study one guide on your role's responsibilities within team comps
Warm-up routine — 15 min
Free play with a communication goal
Weekly review: best call I made, hardest thing to communicate

weeks.title: Advanced Techniques & Mastery
weeks.focus: Refine advanced mechanics and deepen mastery of your hero pool.

tasks.text: Extended aim/movement workshop routine — 20 min
Drill one hard mechanic per main hero (e.g., dive timings, hook angles, tracking paths)
Play 2 matches deliberately using the drilled mechanic
Warm-up routine — 15 min
Pick your 2 strongest heroes + 1 flex; bench everything else this week
Play 2–3 matches only on that pool
Warm-up routine — 15 min
Custom-game sparring: practice against your hardest counter — 15 min
Play matches; note what adjustment won you the duel each time you died to the same hero
Warm-up routine — 15 min
Watch 20 min of a top-ladder player on your main; copy exactly one habit today
Play 2 matches applying that copied habit
Warm-up routine — 15 min
Play 2 matches where you keep a stat sheet of your deaths by cause
Identify your #1 repeat death cause and set a rule to fix it
Warm-up routine — 15 min
Free play on your narrowed hero pool
Weekly review: mechanic gains, habits that stuck

weeks.title: Competitive Preparation
weeks.focus: Prepare routines and mindset for consistent ranked/climb performance.

tasks.text: Build and run your full pre-game routine: warm-up, posture, goals — 20 min
Play 2–3 matches with a stop-loss rule (e.g., stop after 2 straight losses)
Daily note: did structure improve your focus?
Warm-up routine — 15 min
After every match, spend 60 seconds naming one thing to fix next game
Play 3 matches with that micro-review loop
Read current patch notes / meta tier list for your role — 15 min
Test one meta hero or strategy in 2 matches
Decide: adopt, adapt, or discard — write reasoning
Warm-up routine — 15 min
Play a session noticing tilt early; use a reset ritual (breath, mute, stretch) when detected
Note triggers and what broke the spiral
Full competitive block: 4–5 matches treated like ranked placement games
Post-block review: stats, mood, discipline score 1–10
Light warm-up — 10 min
Rest day alternative: watch a tournament set with analytical intent
Weekly review: is my routine competition-ready?

weeks.title: Execution & Next Cycle
weeks.focus: Execute your identity in games, measure growth, and plan continued improvement.

tasks.text: Write your playstyle identity in one sentence (e.g., 'space-creating anchor support')
Play 2–3 matches expressing that identity deliberately
Warm-up routine — 15 min
Compare a Week 1 replay vs today's play; list 3 concrete improvements
Update your rank in Rank History
List your 3 remaining recurring weaknesses from all cycle notes
Play 2 matches targeting your #1 weakness
Explain one concept you mastered this cycle to someone (or write it as if teaching)
Free play — teach through shotcalling in-game
Draft goals for the next cycle using your Weekly Review notes
Optionally edit the program in Task Manager to fit those goals
Play 2 matches with one next-cycle goal already active
Complete the cycle: check final progress page
Export your data as a backup (Settings → Export)
Start Cycle 2 or take a planned rest week
